My only request would be the ability to set more flexible non-daily goals, e.g. every 3 days, rather than every Monday and Thursday.

title: HABIT your way 😉
body:
really unique concept, and cleverly encourages long term habit forming. however, there are a couple of things i would tweak - i think there should be a distinction between ‘failed’ days and days with no data inputted - i sometimes forget whether i’ve remembered to fill in a habit on a day, and to have separate visual cues for each of these conditions would be super helpful. maybe just an X in the box for a failed day and fully blank for ‘no data’?

another thing is the organisation of the widgets - currently, the widget displays the most recent data at the top left, and previous days follows this left to right and descending. I find this (maybe as an english reader) confusing to decipher, and it would make more sense to have the earliest data starting at the top left, and descending from there - perhaps with the ability to scroll up and down once the days overflow the bounds of the widget’s grid…

all in all a well executed app that artfully fulfils its purpose. these few changes, for me, would make the experience even more informative at a glance, especially as a widget user. more colours would be lovely as well (2-colour gradients?!) 

cheers :)
